name: playpen
description: The sessions you are working in right now as small cards above the prompt: a status lamp, a short label, what just happened, and one press to answer or jump there.

window_hours.title: Hours on the board
window_hours.description: A card stays this many hours of your active time after you last wrote in its session. Active time runs only between your prompts; a pause over half an hour, a night or a weekend does not count. A red card stays until handled.

max_cards.title: Maximum cards
max_cards.description: How many cards the band shows at most, three per row.

summarize.title: Short labels
summarize.description: Let a small model write the short label and status line on each card. Off, the card shows the session title and the latest reply cut short.

model.title: Label model
model.description: Model alias or id for the short labels.

auto_red_seconds.title: Red after, in auto mode (seconds)
auto_red_seconds.description: In auto mode the app's classifier decides most permissions in a few seconds, and a plugin cannot tell its thinking from a dialog waiting for you. A card turns red when a call waits for a permission and nothing in the session has moved for this long. Lower: earlier red for a real dialog, more false reds. Other modes turn red at once.
